addendum: A9-LP (minimal local Hall AIR run package on DBF-1.1 with the FE-derived H1 B(z))
amends: nothing: an additive, information-only run set. v1, A1..A8 and every committed record are not edited. The id A9-LP is distinct from the owner-decision series A9.xx.
drafted_by: agent session under A9.39 item 4 (lane-level registration; nothing here is an owner decision)
mandate: A9.39 item 4 (verbatim, docs/decisions/OD_2026_10_09_A9_39_ARCHITECTURE_CLOSED_OWNER_DECISIONS.md): Hall AIR efficiency is NOT AN ARCHITECTURE BLOCKER; prepare one small reproducible local-run package for the owner's local system; DBF-1.1 with the FE B(z); only the minimum decisive RP-1 atmospheric cases for a preliminary operating map (approximately 6-12 cases, not another 196-state campaign); per case: atmospheric composition, mass flow, V_d, I_d, discharge power, magnetic-field operating point, thrust using true time-mean thrust, Isp, efficiency, oscillation statistics, convergence metrics, runtime, failure / collapse reason; one command, one result file.
registered_before: any Hall run on the FE-derived field (DCR-DBF1-002 approval condition: 'a Hall run citing the FE field needs a new NP-HALL-PARAMETRIC-ENVELOPE addendum committed before the run'). Results seen before registration: the v1 XE / AIR records, A3 (incl. the 17 AIR check cases on the surrogate B(z)), the A6 study, the A7 RP-1 demonstration partial (Xe, surrogate B(z)), the Phase 1 numerics diagnosis and the Architecture Closure Conclusion v2. No FE-field Hall result exists.

bz_family.label: FE-DERIVED / NOT MEASURED (scikit-fem 10.0.2 axisymmetric nonlinear magnetostatics of MC-1); EM measured B(z) is the verification-by-test item
bz_family.profiles: nominal BP-LO (h1_fe_v1_Br_centerline_nominal_BP-LO.csv, 1d3930d7...) and BP-HI (h1_fe_v1_Br_centerline_nominal_BP-HI.csv, ab861345...); envelope CORNER-A / CORNER-B and CAP-403 are not run here
bz_family.registration: DBF-1.1 DBF1-BZ-04 rule unchanged: B_profile = {file, align: anode, z_ref_in_file_mm: 0.0, scale_to: max}, B_ref_T = B_peak_G x 1e-4 with B_peak_G the DBF1-BZ-03 operating level (69.93 / 268.6 G); the FE file peaks are 69.91 / 268.61 G (scale 1.00028 / 0.99998)
bz_family.coil_operating_point: reported per case: NI_total of the FE solution at its own B_peak (153.7 A-turns BP-LO, 587.1 A-turns BP-HI; MANIFEST.json)
bz_family.never: not retuned (A9.39 item 1); never pooled with surrogate BZ-P5B16 / P5B30 records

case_selection.geometry: G-RP1 (DBF-1.1 DBF1-H1-01..04: d_mean 70 mm, h 12 mm, L 103.2 mm, r_in 29 mm, r_out 41 mm); domain 0.16923 m as v1 / A7 for G-RP1

SR-1_composition.rule: the two registered NP-HALL-CHEM-AIR composition corners (prereg_v1.json /composition/hall_composition_points, from the frozen 196-state design set abep_sim/data/atmosphere_msis21_orbit_v1_design_states_v2.json, sha256 60073e21...) that bracket the O-nuclei share y_O (0.0794 at ECSS_ST_HIGH 180 km .. 0.8399 at ECSS_LT_LOW 230 km), taken on the diagonal: the fully molecular low-O corner and the dissociated O-dominated corner (f_O 0.990, f_N 0.063). Corners are not interior bounds (COMPOSITION_HULL_CORNERS_NOT_INTERIOR_BOUNDS).

SR-2_Vd.rule: the two upper registered v1 V_d levels inside DBF1-H1-05 (180-350 V); VD-180 is not run: at the DBF1-H1-06 discharge-power band an AIR feed (ionization cost per ion above Xe) favours the higher voltages, and 180 V is already covered as information by the v1 AIR grid on the surrogate field

SR-3_B.rule: the two DBF1-BZ-03 operating levels (ends of the DBF1-BZ-02 band), nominal FE shape

SR-4_mdot.rule: total delivered anode flow; MF-A..MF-C cover the conservation requirement (A4 conservation_bounds_v1: mdot_req 0.048 mg/s at 12 mN and 0.208 mg/s at 25 mN for a lossless thruster at 1500 W; a real thruster needs several times that) at 0.2 / 0.5 / 1.0 mg/s; MF-D = 2.0 mg/s is the one higher level. Split by the composition's registered mass fractions; inlet NI-01 (500 K, 150 m/s x sqrt(M_N2 / M_s)).

SR-5_transport.rule: two of the nine registered screening candidates (hallthruster_bridge/ensemble/transport_ensemble_v0.json, none admitted, credible set EMPTY) at opposite corners of the screening box in every SGB shape parameter: sgb-screen-01 (barrier b 0.8 = lowest, centre 0.9 L = most upstream, width 0.25 L = widest; best in-sample P5 I_d) and sgb-screen-04 (b 0.97 = highest, centre 1.1 L = most downstream, width 0.1 L = narrowest); a = 1/16 for both. sgb-screen-01 carries the map, sgb-screen-04 is the transport-sensitivity replicate.

SR-6_design.rule: fractional design: the half fraction of composition x V_d x B with defining relation I = comp.Vd.B (coded CP-YLO-REC / VD-265 / BP-LO = -1) gives four rows; each flow level gets two rows that differ in composition (composition is not controllable, so every flow level sees both), and every row appears twice over the four flow levels; plus the two MF-C rows replicated with sgb-screen-04. 10 cases, 20 runs (A7-P + A7-C).

case_selection.no_n2_proxy: AIR runs use the four-neutral AIR feed and the AIR reaction set; no N2_PROXY substitution

case_file.generator: tools/local_runs/hall_air_rp1_v1/make_cases.jl (generate | check: byte-reproducible from the sha256-checked registered sources)

numerical_method.basis: A7 unchanged (levels, window, observables, SE rule): production A7-P = 678 cells (0.25 mm), dt 2.5 ns; check A7-C = 1356 cells (0.125 mm), dt 1.25 ns; duration 13.5384 ms (4 x v1), window from 3.3846 ms (1 x v1) to the end, 4000 saved frames; pinned solver defaults written into every case (adaptive, CFL 0.799, min / max dt 1e-10 / 1e-7 s, max_small_steps 100, reconstruct on, implicit energy 1.0)
numerical_method.implementation: tools/local_runs/hall_air_rp1_v1/hall_air_rp1_lib.jl: the Config of air_bridge_lib.jl run_case_air (AIR propellant config, per-species feed, vacuum mode) with the A7 numerics; a7_simparams and a7_window_stats evaluated from hallthruster_bridge/a7_numerics.jl unchanged. The A7 bridge refuses non-Xe cases, so the AIR path is this package's, not a7_record.
numerical_method.observables: thrust = time-mean of the per-frame instantaneous thrust(sol, i); I_d = time-mean of the per-frame discharge current; batch-means SE (10 batches); half-window means; integrated autocorrelation time; reported only: thrust of the time-averaged state
numerical_method.per_case_outputs: composition, feed, mass flow, V_d, I_d +- SE, discharge power, B operating point (profile id, B_peak, coil A-turns, file sha256), thrust +- SE, Isp = T / (mdot g0), anode efficiency T^2 / (2 mdot V_d I_d) (time-means) and the frame-mean of the solver's anode_eff, efficiency decomposition (mass, current, voltage, divergence), total efficiency NOT_EVALUATED (needs the non-discharge loads of bus_power_boundary_a9_v2), oscillation statistics (dominant frequency, RMS, peak-to-peak for I_d and thrust), convergence (A7-P vs A7-C, half-window means, stationarity, SE), runtime per level, status and failure / collapse diagnostics (retcode, error, time I_d falls below 1 % of its running maximum, last-frame n_e,min and T_e,max, first non-finite variable / cell / z)

run_status_rule.precedence: NUMERICAL_FAILURE > EXTINCT > OUT_OF_DOMAIN > NOT_SUSTAINED > NON_STATIONARY > STATISTICALLY_UNRESOLVED > PASS; NOT_RUN when the record is absent (a partial package run)
run_status_rule.EXTINCT: A7 rule with the AIR feed: mean I_d < 1e-3 x e x sum_s(mdot_s / m_s) (air_nominal.toml masses)
run_status_rule.OUT_OF_DOMAIN: A1 AIR rule: DOM-AIR-01 (per-table activity share beyond its validity limit > 1e-12, or an unresolved table) or DOM-AIR-02 (activity share above 45 eV mean energy > 1e-12), per saved frame over the window. Numbers are still reported, labelled.
run_status_rule.classes: PASS and NOT_SUSTAINED are evaluated physics; every other status is an unknown

convergence_rule: A7 unchanged: C-STATUS, C-QUIET, C-T, C-ID; outcomes CONVERGED_EVALUATED / PERSISTENT_UNKNOWN / NOT_CONVERGED; INCOMPLETE_NOT_RUN when a level is missing

execution.where: the owner's machine (A9.39 item 4); one command tools/local_runs/hall_air_rp1_v1/run_all.sh; one result file hall_air_rp1_v1_results.json (schema results_schema_v1.json, validator validate.jl)
execution.in_container_reference: before hand-over, the package is run once end to end in the authoring container on the registered subset C02, C05, C06 (both levels; low-flow and conservation-relevant flow, both compositions, both B levels) with 3 parallel jobs, because the full 20-run set exceeds the container budget; that output is committed as a reference labelled with its host and is never merged with the owner's results
execution.provenance: host, OS, CPU, Julia and HallThruster.jl versions and commit, Manifest sha256, thread / BLAS environment, case-file and package / input-file sha256 (package_manifest_v1.json), per-run wall time

what_this_is_not: not measured or demonstrated H1 performance; atmospheric Hall performance is verified on the Engineering Model (A9.39 item 4)
not a closure, selection, non-closure or constraint verdict; it changes no M2 record and no architecture item
not a validation: the transports are unadmitted screening candidates and the AIR chemistry is a bounded variant
never pooled with surrogate-B(z) records; literature values are never presented as measured
change_control: any change of a case, rule or level after the lock is a new, dated addendum (v2) with a new case file; package-code fixes that change no rule are recorded by their sha256 in every result file
